claims.statement: A founder can approach the control point through certified HVAC and heat-pump installers: EU rules assign recovery to certified persons and require operator records identifying service and recovery actors, making an installer-led pickup mandate and cylinder chain-of-custody a plausible contractual wedge. Access to enough certified partners is not yet proven.

Decommissioning or servicing F-gas equipment creates a present, auditable event: gas must be recovered and then recycled, reclaimed, or destroyed; mishandled or unassayed material loses potential resale value and still incurs handling effort. The frequency and recoverable yield in a Polish regional route remain unknown.

The initial payer hypothesis is a dual-sided one: equipment operators or installers fund compliant pickup from service and waste-handling budgets, while reclaimers or gas wholesalers pay for accepted recovered lots from procurement budgets. The cited implementing-rule update confirms labeling, reporting, and certification activity but does not establish willingness to pay this intermediary.

contrary_evidence: The same regulation accelerates adoption of low-GWP and natural refrigerants, so the addressable bank of valuable high-GWP gas should eventually shrink.
Large refrigerant wholesalers can add take-back programs and may already control reclamation economics.

economics.acquisition_route: Use the family renewable installer as a nonexclusive design partner, recruit 5-10 certified regional HVAC firms with consignment pickup agreements, and place recovered cylinders with one licensed reclaimer before buying assay equipment.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A dense Polish collection network could expand into multi-country refrigerant inventory and provenance infrastructure, producing transaction margin plus recurring chain-of-custody software revenue; the volume required to reach the founder objective is unvalidated.
economics.founder_time: Pilot can be coordinated in roughly 12-18 hours per week, with hazardous-material transport and field handling outsourced to qualified partners.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Target margin is the spread between pickup/assay/transport cost and reclaimer purchase price plus a service fee; no spread is assumed until two counterparties quote the same test lot.
economics.payback: Seek payback on cylinders, logistics, and sampling within two collection turns, otherwise remain a broker rather than an inventory owner.
economics.pricing: Per-kilogram accepted-lot spread plus a fixed pickup and documentation fee; future software priced per certified technician or depot.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recovery repeats at service, leak repair, retrofit, and decommissioning events; route density and accepted-quality history should improve repeat economics.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Installer pickup density, assayed yield history, and trusted provenance for each refrigerant lot
fingerprint.customer: Certified HVAC and heat-pump installers, equipment operators, and licensed refrigerant reclaimers in Poland
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Regional installer partnerships and scheduled cylinder backhaul embedded in service routes
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed recovery aggregation and provenance service earning pickup fees, reclaimed-gas spread, and later ledger subscriptions
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator or installer pays at service/decommissioning; reclaimer pays when an assayed lot is accepted
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A service or decommissioning job yields refrigerant that must be recovered, documented, and routed

founder_fit: The parents' installation company offers a credible first channel into adjacent certified trades without requiring a public persona.
The founder can build forecasting, routing, lot-quality, and provenance systems while outsourcing regulated physical handling.
The wedge can be validated with small consignments before material inventory capital is committed.
risks: Polish waste, dangerous-goods transport, and F-gas trading rules may require licenses or exclude the proposed intermediary role.
Contamination or mislabeling could destroy a lot's value or create liability.
Low regional recovery volumes may never support economical route density.

structure.commercial_archetype: Circular commodity aggregation with traceability and reverse logistics
structure.control_point: Contracted custody of recovered refrigerant at the installer pickup moment and its accepted provenance record
structure.critical_dependency: Legal ability to aggregate material and a reclaimer willing to buy economically sized, assayed lots

thesis: Backcast from a 2032 market in which restricted virgin F-gases make traceable reclaimed material strategically valuable: win the present installer recovery handoff, aggregate compliant lots, and let route density plus assay history become the defensible bank.
title: Refrigerant Recovery Bank
uncertainties: Kilograms and quality grades recoverable per regional installer per quarter are unknown.
The price spread between recovered, reclaimed, and virgin gases in Poland needs live quotes.
Whether installers will grant exclusive pickup rights rather than use wholesaler take-back is unresolved.
